_comment: Documented examples that are ABRIDGED FRAGMENTS, not complete documents. Suppressing one asserts 'a user copying this verbatim would correctly get an error, because upstream printed only part of a file'. It must never be used to silence a genuine false positive - that is the whole point of the gate. Every entry needs a reason, and a stale entry (one whose example no longer exists) is a hard failure.

fragments.reason: Partial marketplace manifest. Upstream is illustrating plugin `source` variants and prints only `name` + `plugins`, omitting the required top-level `owner`. A real marketplace.json without `owner` IS invalid, so the error is correct here. (Was :751 before the baseline refresh moved it; `owner` remains documented as required at plugin-marketplaces.md:155.)
